contracts.label: TownlightRecords search bridge
contracts.absent_dependency_behavior: TownlightMeetings keeps local public archive search authoritative and returns an actionable unavailable-state contract instead of implying TownlightRecords is live.
contracts.operator_fix: When TownlightRecords is installed, configure its base URL and token in deployment secrets, run the adversarial mock search suite, then enable cross-module search.
adversarial_scenarios: closed-session result withheld from anonymous search
TownlightRecords unavailable fallback preserves local public archive search
source citations are required before a result can enter minutes or packet work

contracts.label: TownlightCode adopted-action handoff
contracts.absent_dependency_behavior: TownlightMeetings stores the handoff locally as READY_FOR_CODE_OR_LEGAL_REVIEW and keeps a file-export path available until TownlightCode is reachable.
contracts.operator_fix: After TownlightCode is deployed, point the handoff client at the TownlightCode intake endpoint and replay pending READY_FOR_CODE_OR_LEGAL_REVIEW records.
adversarial_scenarios: handoff cannot reference a motion from another meeting
payload without legal reviewer is rejected before export
duplicate replay uses the same idempotency key

contracts.label: Codification-system fallback export
contracts.absent_dependency_behavior: If TownlightCode or a codifier API is absent, TownlightMeetings produces a checksumed handoff packet for the clerk/legal/codifier workflow without auto-codifying.
contracts.operator_fix: Give the export bundle to the codifier or configure the future adapter, then record the external codification reference on the adopted item.
adversarial_scenarios: export labels pending ordinance language separately from adopted law
legal advice text is never generated by the export helper

contracts.label: City website CMS posting
contracts.absent_dependency_behavior: TownlightMeetings continues to serve its resident portal and produces a CMS-ready posting preview until a city-specific CMS adapter is configured.
contracts.operator_fix: Select the city CMS adapter, store credentials outside the app, run the mock publish/withdrawal suite, then let the clerk confirm each posting.
adversarial_scenarios: publish is blocked without clerk confirmation
CMS 403 returns exact permission fix guidance

contracts.label: Vendor live API adapters
contracts.absent_dependency_behavior: TownlightMeetings records source configuration, health, cursor resets, and run outcomes without pulling vendor networks until a controlled adapter run is explicitly enabled.
contracts.operator_fix: Use local export-drop ingestion until IT approves a source URL, credentials are in deployment secrets, and the no-network hostile vendor suite passes.
adversarial_scenarios: pagination must finish before cursor advance
schema drift produces field-level import failures
partial outage records partial run status
stale delta keeps previous success cursor

checks.message: Anonymous TownlightRecords mock search does not expose closed-session results.
checks.fix: Keep closed-session result expansion behind archive_reader or city_attorney roles.

checks.message: TownlightRecords unavailable mock keeps TownlightMeetings local archive search available with fix guidance.
checks.fix: Continue with TownlightMeetings local archive search, then retry TownlightRecords after IT restores the service.

checks.message: TownlightCode handoff mock generates stable idempotency keys for replayed adopted actions.
checks.fix: Reuse the idempotency key when replaying pending TownlightCode handoff records.

checks.message: Codification fallback mock includes a checksum and separates adopted text from legal advice.
checks.fix: Regenerate the export manifest if checksum, adoption label, or source references are missing.

checks.message: CMS posting mock blocks publication until the clerk confirms the preview.
checks.fix: Have the clerk approve the preview, then submit the city-specific CMS adapter publish action.

body.fix: Keep using adversarial mocks as the release proof. When a real dependency appears, enable it only after its contract suite passes and credentials are stored outside the repo.
